capabilities: Open Markdown notes as editable mind maps
Sync selection between the map and the Markdown text
Embed live maps or single branches inside other notes
Export maps to PNG, JPEG, SVG, PDF, HTML and Canvas
extras: Previously named MindMark; maps made with MindMark and with Enhancing Mindmap open unchanged. Interface is in English and Simplified Chinese. No accounts, ads or telemetry; it goes online only to download web images when exporting. Requires Obsidian 1.8.7 or later.
problem: The heading and list structure of a Markdown note is hard to see and rearrange while writing in plain text.

relations.evidence: The idea of editing Markdown notes as mind maps in Obsidian was inspired by Enhancing Mindmap.
import .xmind files (XMind 2020+, Zen and XMind 8) as new notes, and export maps back to .xmind

summary: Mind-map view of a Markdown note that edits the same .md file and keeps the text and map in sync.
